facts.title: Ayaan Buildtech current corporate profile and satisfied charges
points: Current corporate-data indexing identifies Ayaan Buildtech Private Limited as active, CIN U45209DL2012PTC234251, incorporated 12 April 2012, with authorised capital ₹14 crore and paid-up capital ₹13.08 crore.

The indexed MCA-derived profile reports no open charges and ₹16.06 crore of satisfied charges. It records the ₹15 crore Karnataka Bank charge created 05 October 2015 as satisfied on 14 July 2022, and a ₹1.06 crore Karnataka Bank charge created 29 October 2020 as satisfied on 07 November 2022.
The same source reports FY2025 revenue ₹11.43 crore and five current directors. These are corporate-data/MCA-derived secondary records; formal reliance should use current MCA filings.
facts.confidence: Secondary corporate corroboration; formal MCA verification recommended

facts.title: Secondary RERA-data index reports three extensions through 31 Dec 2021
points: A current Rajasthan real-estate data index identifies MAX HEIIGHTS MAJESTIC by Ayaan Buildtech Private Limited, Jaipur, with land area 31,354 sq.m.
It reports three completion-deadline extensions on record, with the latest deadline 31 December 2021.
This is secondary RERA-data aggregation. Each extension should be tied to its underlying Rajasthan RERA certificate/order before treating all three extension events as primary verified evidence.
facts.confidence: Corroborated lead; underlying extension documents preferred

facts.title: Legacy web sources conflict strongly on floors and units
points: An old PinkCity project page describes STILT + 13 floors and approximately 770 units, while current CommonFloor reports 462 units and another Jaipur property source reports 454 units/15 floors.
The user-supplied site maintenance notice totals 454 flats. Current Square Yards also reports 454 units.
These portal figures must not override tower-wise sanctioned RERA/JDA plans. The conflict is retained to prevent the search engine from presenting a legacy marketing figure as an official fact.
facts.source: PinkCity legacy page + CommonFloor current page + JaipurPropertyHouse/SquareYards + user site notice
facts.confidence: Conflicting secondary/site evidence; primary sanctioned plan controls

facts.title: Current resale listing suggests at least one 13-floor building context
points: A current Housing.com resale listing within Max Heiights Majestic states that the listed flat is on floor 7 and the building has 13 total floors.
This is only a resale-listing lead and does not identify or prove the sanctioned configuration of every tower.
It supports keeping tower-wise floor configuration separate rather than applying one project-wide floor count.
